theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_id_tpd_plane_cutoff
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (P : Submodule ℝ (Euclidean N)) (a R : ℝ), Module.finrank ℝ P = n → 0 < a → a < R → ∃ f : C_c(Euclidean N, ℝ), (∀ y, 0 ≤ f y) ∧ (∀ y, f y ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ y, ‖y‖ ≤ a → f y = 1) ∧ (∀ y, R < ‖y‖ → f y = 0) ∧ (unitBallVolume n).toReal * a ^ n ≤ ∫ y in (P : Set (Euclidean N)), f y ∂μHE[n] ∧ ∫ y in (P : Set (Euclidean N)), f y ∂μHE[n] ≤ (unitBallVolume n).toReal * R ^ n
